scripts.pr:verify: npm run build -w @kardata/agents && npm run lint --workspaces && npm run typecheck --workspaces && npm run test --workspaces && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.quality:dup: jscpd agents/src && jscpd backend/src && jscpd frontend/src
scripts.quality:deps: cd agents && npx --no-install depcruise --config ../.dependency-cruiser.cjs --ts-config tsconfig.json src && cd ../backend && npx --no-install depcruise --config ../.dependency-cruiser.cjs --ts-config tsconfig.json src ../scripts ../deployment/scripts && cd ../frontend && npx --no-install depcruise --config ../.dependency-cruiser.cjs --ts-config tsconfig.app.json src
scripts.quality: npm run quality:knip && npm run quality:dup && npm run quality:deps
scripts.test:mutation: stryker run stryker.agents.json -m agents/src/turnRunner.ts && stryker run stryker.backend.json -m backend/src/db/workspace.ts && stryker run stryker.backend.json -m backend/src/mcp/tools.ts && stryker run stryker.backend.json -m backend/src/temporal/activities/turn.ts && stryker run stryker.frontend.json -m frontend/src/data/useWorkspace.ts
scripts.verify: npm run pr:verify && npm run quality
scripts.verify:full: node -e "if(!process.env.TEST_DATABASE_URL){console.error('verify:full needs TEST_DATABASE_URL');process.exit(1)}" && npm run verify && npm test -w @kardata/backend && KARDATA_TEMPORAL_TEST=1 npm test -w @kardata/backend && npm run test:e2e -w frontend
scripts.hooks:install: git config core.hooksPath scripts/hooks && echo hooks installed from scripts/hooks
scripts.prom:check: docker run --rm --entrypoint promtool -v ./deployment:/rules prom/prometheus:v3.0.0 check rules /rules/prometheus-rules.yaml
scripts.prom:test: docker run --rm --entrypoint promtool -v ./deployment:/rules prom/prometheus:v3.0.0 test rules /rules/prometheus-rules.test.yaml
